content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Fire protection, safety systems and building MEP installation for buildings, unlike Team's plant inspection and repair work."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Civil engineering, surveying and planning consulting for developers and agencies, not on-site industrial plant services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Utility and telecom network construction for gas, electric and fiber operators, not industrial plant inspection or repair."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Forensic engineering and expert consulting sold to law firms and insurers, not hands-on plant inspection or repair."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pumps, valves, brake components and connectors; sells equipment rather than field inspection and repair services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Freight trucking, intermodal and logistics for shippers, a transportation business with no industrial plant services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Government-focused engineering, consulting and program management, not industrial inspection or repair for plant operators."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Building mechanical, electrical and controls services for commercial buildings, not refinery or petrochemical plant work."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Building MEP contracting and maintenance for commercial and institutional buildings, a different customer and service set."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Telecom, power and pipeline construction under multi-year contracts; construction focus differs from Team's inspection and repair services."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Staffing of engineers, healthcare workers and IT professionals billed by hour, not physical inspection or repair services."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Mainly manufactures heat tracing products and heaters; its field services are secondary and differ from Team's inspection and repair."}]}
